title: The right-unit equation determines the unit comparison
statement: Let D be any monoidal category, let e : I ≅ V and q : V ⊗ W ≅ Z, and let a,b : I ⟶ W. If tensor(id_V,a) ≫ q.hom = tensor(id_V,b) ≫ q.hom, then a=b. No additive, symmetry or source-category hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Cancel the invertible map q.hom to identify the two tensor maps.

The functor V ⊗ - is naturally isomorphic to I ⊗ - via tensoring e with identities. The latter is naturally isomorphic to the identity by the left unitor. Transport faithfulness across these natural isomorphisms, and use its injectivity on morphisms.

from.place: Checking the edge case of independently varying the unit comparison

lean.statement:
theorem tensorUnitComparison_unique
    {D : Type u} [Category.{v} D] [MonoidalCategory D]
    {V W Z : D} (e : 𝟙_ D ≅ V) (q : V ⊗ W ≅ Z)
    (a b : 𝟙_ D ⟶ W)
    (h : (tensor D).map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 V) a) ≫ q.hom =
      (tensor D).map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 V) b) ≫ q.hom) : a = b
